description: Redeem tokenback: the tokens' cash value (1 token = 1¢) lands on the user's rewards card as spending power. The rewards card is permanent and locked to AI-lab merchants (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) — created on first redemption, topped up after. Check get_rewards first for the balance and the minimum. Ask the user before redeeming.

tokens.description: How many tokens to redeem (1 token = 1 cent, so 500 tokens = $5.00 of wallet credit).

name: redeem_rewards

amountCents.description: Wallet credit in cents. Present when status is "redeemed".

deliveredCardId.description: Rewards card the value landed on, when delivery completed inline. Absent = the value sits as wallet credit (it reaches the rewards card within a few minutes when delivery is enabled).

deliveredCardLast4.description: Last 4 digits of the rewards card, when delivered inline.

redemptionId.description: The redemption ID. Present when status is "redeemed".

status.description: "redeemed" on success; an error discriminator otherwise (e.g. "below_minimum", "insufficient_tokens", "redemption_in_progress").
